preconditions.description: The number of votes must be between 1 and 1000.
The length of each vote must be between 1 and 26.

preconditions.expression: all(len(vote) == len(votes[0]) for vote in votes)
preconditions.description: All votes must have the same length.

preconditions.expression: all(vote[i] in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for vote in votes for i in range(len(vote)))
preconditions.description: All characters in the votes must be uppercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(vote)) == len(vote) for vote in votes)
preconditions.description: All characters in each vote must be unique.

preconditions.expression: all(set(votes[0]) == set(vote) for vote in votes)
preconditions.description: All teams in the first vote must be present in all other votes.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ''.join(sorted(votes[0], key=lambda team: (-sum(vote[i] == team for vote in votes), team)))
postconditions.description: The output must be a string of teams sorted by the ranking system.
